features.title: skill-eval lib: fixtures, probes, assertions
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd skill-eval can discover and score deterministic fixtures under cli/eval/skills/<skill>/ and report a pass rate per skill.
features.evidence: RED recorded in sess-skill-eval-005 (module missing). GREEN: `node --test cli/src/harness/skill-eval-lib.test.mjs` → 12/12 pass (discovery, loadFixtures, readSkillBody, probes cwd work/repo, setup+file assertions, skill_contains/lacks, baseline improved/regressed/unchanged via git show, invalid JSON case, report format).
features.notes: RED first: failing test recorded in feature_started session evidence.

features.title: CLI entry, --baseline delta, registration
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd skill-eval [--skill <name>] [--json] [--baseline <ref>] runs the fixtures, reports improved/regressed/unchanged vs a git ref, and exits non-zero naming regressed fixtures.
features.evidence: RED recorded in sess-skill-eval-007 (unknown command). GREEN: `node cli/bin/asdd.mjs skill-eval --json` runs the suite (empty fixtures → ok:false, exit 1); `node cli/bin/asdd.mjs help` lists skill-eval; `node --test cli/src/harness/skill-eval-lib.test.mjs` → 12/12 incl. baseline deltas (REQ-003) and regressed-naming (REQ-004).
features.notes: RED first: failing test recorded in feature_started session evidence. Baseline reads skill body via git show <ref>:<path>, never checks out.

features.title: Starter fixtures + README + versions
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd skill-eval scores real fixtures for asdd-status, asdd-next and codegraph; README documents the command; cli/versions.json is regenerated.
verification: node cli/bin/asdd.mjs kit versions && grep -q skill-eval-lib.mjs cli/versions.json
features.notes: Fixtures must be deterministic (files, commands, exit codes); no live model or runtime adapter — STOP and report if one is needed (E1/E4).
